name: Acceptance tab
description: The browser row's island clauses' fixture: a third-party plugin, installed from its folder, with an entry that is a tab of the island and another that puts a line on it (the island's island.line point). Its client is TSX that draws a line of its own words; its host half keeps the one line the run tells it to show (the command acceptance-tab.say). No network.

commands.name: acceptance-tab.say
commands.description: Sets the line the plugin puts on the island, or clears it when no text is given.
